code:
# Compile separately (each .c = one translation unit):
gcc -c math_utils.c -o math_utils.o
gcc -c main.c -o main.o
# Link:
gcc math_utils.o main.o -o program

# This is how large C projects work: Makefile compiles .c files
# independently, only relinking when needed.
description: These commands compile two C translation units separately and then link them into one program.

steps.description: Each C source file compiles independently into its own object file.
The linker combines math_utils.o and main.o into program.
The comment connects this separate compilation model to Makefiles in large C projects.

title: Compile translation units
